rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when bringing a dying or drowned person back to life.

example.english: They managed to resuscitate him after he nearly drowned.
example.traditional: 佢浸親冇晒氣，最後都畀人救活喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zam6 can1 mou5 saai3 hei3 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 bei2 jan4 gau3 wut6 laa3

rows.jyutping: ling6 A fui1 fuk6 cing1 sing2
rows.note: Use this when the specific result is restoring someone’s consciousness rather than emphasizing saving their life.

example.english: After emergency treatment, the doctors managed to resuscitate him and restore his consciousness.
example.traditional: 醫生急救之後，令佢恢復清醒。
example.jyutping: ji1 saang1 gap1 gau3 zi1 hau6 ling6 keoi5 fui1 fuk6 cing1 sing2
